description: The radar chart that plays fair. Compare teams, products, vendors or KPIs across any number of dimensions - on a scale that stays put when slicers change, with axes in the order you chose, and with the analytical depth the built-in options never had. Free forever - and never blocked Up to 3 series with unlimited axes, plus every cosmetic option: 4 themes, line / area / spline styles, marker shapes, polygon or circle grid, rotation, legend, data labels. Fully customizable - every color, font and shape is yours to override. Honest scale controls: pin the minimum and maximum so the chart stops rescaling with every slicer click (the classic radar trap), start axes at zero, order axes alphabetically, by value, or exactly as in your data. No lock-out, ever. Unlicensed viewers always see the full free tier - no watermark, no broken visual, no blocked report. Premium: the analytical stack (per-user license) 4 or more series - compare as many teams or products as your story needs, or split one measure by a Legend field. Normalization for mixed units: min-max, percentile rank or z-score per axis, so speed, price and NPS compare fairly on one chart. Inverted axes: mark axes where lower is better (price, error rate) so "further out" always means "better". Target polygon: map a Target field and every series is judged against a dashed goal shape. Zone bands and reference line: red / amber /…
